nodes.label: Evidence and Status Labels
nodes.rationale: OBSERVED/DOCUMENTED/REPORTED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/PROPOSED/DECIDED make the provenance of every claim explicit so stale or unverified facts are re-checked before reliance.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Simple to operate on a few machines; no microservices without demonstrated need (principle 7).

nodes.label: Manual Request Service
nodes.rationale: Very little is bookable from Iran, so manual requests and staff options are a first-class path, not a fallback (milestone M1, week 9).

nodes.label: Project Roadmap Phases
nodes.rationale: Booklet is the deliverable for phases 2-4; implementation (phase 5) starts only after approval.

nodes.label: Amadeus Flight Builder Discovery
nodes.rationale: Read-only discovery of the existing Amadeus Flight Builder panel (phase 1) is still outstanding; scheduled in Stage 0.

nodes.label: Truth Before Convenience
nodes.rationale: Every flight carries source and time; nothing shown as booked until a reservation/ticket exists; unknown baggage stays unknown.

nodes.label: A Request Is Not a Booking
nodes.rationale: Search results, requests, quotes, reservations, tickets and payments are separate objects with separate lifecycles.

nodes.label: Backend Is the Authority
nodes.rationale: Roles, permissions, statuses and flight data decided server-side; clients render.

nodes.label: Compliance by Design
nodes.rationale: Screening and policies run before staff act; counsel's answers become configuration.

nodes.label: Configuration Over Code
nodes.rationale: Hubs, gateways, connection rules, workflows, templates and policies are versioned data editable in the Developer Panel.

nodes.label: Built for Iranian Conditions
nodes.rationale: No Google dependencies in critical paths, SMS fallback, light pages, honest failure during shutdowns.

nodes.label: Simple to Operate
nodes.rationale: Modular monolith on few machines; no extra infrastructure without demonstrated need.

nodes.label: Provider-Agnostic
nodes.rationale: Suppliers sit behind adapters; switching one off never breaks the product.

nodes.label: Decision D-01
nodes.rationale: Iranian carriers excluded by default via compliance policy changeable only with counsel approval [DECIDED]

nodes.label: Decision D-02
nodes.rationale: Version 1 is request-based; staff reserve and ticket in existing tools and record results [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-03
nodes.rationale: No online payments in v1; staff record offline payments; Stripe parked [DECIDED]

nodes.label: Decision D-04
nodes.rationale: Ticket types means flight fare variants; ground, charter/group, rail/ferry out of scope [DECIDED]

nodes.label: Decision D-05
nodes.rationale: Cargo covers documents/parcels, excess baggage, air freight; Iran lanes start disabled pending counsel [DECIDED (scope) / PROPOSED (lanes)]

nodes.label: Decision D-06
nodes.rationale: Stack follows Engineering Kit; additions (Expo, pnpm/Turborepo, Zod, TanStack Query, Pino/OpenTelemetry, Docker/Caddy) need approval [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-07
nodes.rationale: Seat maps: preference in v1, view-only in Stage 3, selection only with automated booking [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-08
nodes.rationale: Gateway departures shown with information-only access notes; overland travel not sold [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-09
nodes.rationale: English and Persian at launch with Jalali date display [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-10
nodes.rationale: Host in UK/EU with vendors checked for Iranian reachability and sanctions terms; no Google services in critical paths [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-11
nodes.rationale: One mobile app with role-based customer and admin modes; Developer Panel web only [PROPOSED]

nodes.label: Decision D-12
nodes.rationale: Telegram is not part of version 1 [DECIDED]

nodes.label: Gateway Airports
nodes.rationale: Turkish (Van, Erzurum, Istanbul) and Armenian (Yerevan) gateways reached overland because few flights leave Iran.

nodes.label: Internet Shutdowns in Iran
nodes.rationale: Site outside Iran unreachable during shutdowns; platform fails honestly, domestic SMS returns first, staff work via alternative contacts.

nodes.label: Strict-Liability Penalties
nodes.rationale: UK sanctions breaches need no proof of intent, making compliance a first-order design concern.

nodes.label: Truth Ladder
nodes.rationale: Schedules may guide where to search, only offers can be shown as options, only reservations and tickets as booked.

nodes.label: No Scraping Rule
nodes.rationale: Scraped metasearch data is unauthorised, unstable and not bookable; excluded by Uni Travel's rules.

nodes.label: Amadeus Enterprise
nodes.rationale: Primary: existing Amadeus UK relationship; Master Pricer returns availability, fares, taxes, baggage and conditions in one response; Self-Service closed 17 Jul 2026.

nodes.label: Duffel
nodes.rationale: Secondary: self-serve test tokens, modern REST, seat maps, NDC/LCC content; offers are single orders and expire quickly.

nodes.label: Seat Map Rendering Rules
nodes.rationale: Render rows/sections exactly as supplied with designators on every seat; cabin not mirrored in RTL; never generic layouts passed off as real.

nodes.label: Cargo Partner Model
nodes.rationale: No mainstream carrier serves Iran, so cargo works only as request-and-quote through vetted partners behind a compliance gate.

nodes.label: Roles
nodes.rationale: Backend checks permissions, never role names, so roles can be reshaped without code changes.

nodes.label: Hiding a Button Is Not Security
nodes.rationale: Every protected endpoint checks permissions on the server; clients receive the permission list only for display.

nodes.label: J1 Sign Up and Sign In
J2 Search and Request an Itinerary
One-Time Code Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Phone primary, email alternative; OTP means no passwords to leak or reset.

nodes.label: Verified Means Verified
nodes.rationale: A phone is shown verified only when the server holds a successful OTP for that exact E.164 number; requests snapshot contact and verification state.

nodes.label: Baggage and Conditions Hard Rule
nodes.rationale: Platform never invents baggage or fare conditions; UNKNOWN shows 'Not provided' and the quote builder forces the admin to fill it before sending.

nodes.label: Ticketing Models
nodes.rationale: How the journey is ticketed decides who bears missed-connection risk, so it is shown prominently.

nodes.label: Seven Distinct Objects
nodes.rationale: Search result, offer snapshot, request, quote, reservation, ticket and payment each have their own table, owner and lifecycle so nothing is shown as booked before it is.

nodes.label: Derived Customer Status Invariant
nodes.rationale: Customer-facing status derived from objects, never typed freely; 'Ticket issued' only with ISSUED ticket per traveller.

nodes.label: Request State Machine
nodes.rationale: Named commands in one module inside a DB transaction writing history, audit and outbox atomically; 409 INVALID_TRANSITION when guards fail.

nodes.label: Reference Numbers
nodes.rationale: Random Crockford Base32 codes leak no volume, avoid ambiguous characters for phone reading; a reference is a lookup handle, not a credential.

nodes.label: After-sales Request
nodes.rationale: Linked UT-A case so ticketed request history is never rewritten

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Append-only, optional hash chain for tamper evidence

nodes.label: Payment Record
nodes.rationale: verified_by must differ from recorded_by above threshold

nodes.label: Decision D-05 Cargo Services in Version 1
nodes.rationale: Uni Travel brokers via partners; all shipments staff-quoted, nothing auto-priced in v1

nodes.label: Iran Lane Counsel Sign-off
nodes.rationale: UK sanctions/export controls are strict-liability; Iran lanes created disabled until counsel approves

nodes.label: Chargeable Weight
nodes.rationale: Greater of actual and volumetric (LxWxH / lane divisor), shown as estimate

nodes.label: Goods Screening
nodes.rationale: Category list is configuration approved by counsel, not legal guidance

nodes.label: Re-weigh Exception
nodes.rationale: Chargeable weight change beyond 5% tolerance forces a revised quote

nodes.label: Cargo Quote
nodes.rationale: Partner cost and margin stored internally, never sent to clients

nodes.label: Service Availability Register
nodes.rationale: Carrier/courier coverage of lanes changes monthly; entries older than 30 days flagged

nodes.label: Air Waybill (AWB)
nodes.rationale: 11 digits; check digit = first seven digits mod 7, validated in console

nodes.label: Admin Panel
nodes.rationale: Deliberately plain; configuration lives in Developer Panel

nodes.label: Commands, Not Fields
nodes.rationale: Admins never edit status; server computes allowed actions from state and permissions

nodes.label: Re-check Price
nodes.rationale: Calls supplier again and shows difference without altering the snapshot

nodes.label: Template SMS
nodes.rationale: Free-text SMS off by default to control cost and content

nodes.label: Tri-state Attribute
nodes.rationale: Baggage/conditions are KNOWN/NOT_INCLUDED/UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN blocks sending a quote

nodes.label: Mobile Admin Mode
nodes.rationale: Quote sending and recording excluded on mobile to reduce small-screen errors

nodes.label: Provider Credentials
nodes.rationale: Write-only, encrypted at rest, never displayed or sent to clients

nodes.label: Rule Simulator
nodes.rationale: Runs draft rules against cached supplier responses, no new supplier calls

nodes.label: Versioned Configuration
nodes.rationale: ADR-07: rules are versioned data; audited, reversible, no redeploy

nodes.label: In-app Inbox
nodes.rationale: System of record for every notification

nodes.label: Push Notifications
nodes.rationale: FCM unavailable to Iranian IPs; non-FCM provider piloted

nodes.label: SMS Channel
nodes.rationale: Persian UCS-2 limits a segment to 70 characters

nodes.label: SMS Escalation
nodes.rationale: Immediate for +98 users without working push; throttled 1/request/hour

nodes.label: On-duty Admin Alerts
nodes.rationale: Avoids alert fatigue; hourly digest outside business hours

nodes.label: Modular Monolith (ADR-01)
nodes.rationale: Simple deployment, local transactions; modules communicate via interfaces and events so splitting later is possible

nodes.label: Worker Process Role
nodes.rationale: Only the worker calls suppliers and messaging providers (except inline price re-check)

nodes.label: BullMQ
nodes.rationale: ADR-04: delayed jobs implement SLA timers that survive restarts

nodes.label: Mobile App
nodes.rationale: Booklet proposes Expo; superseded by ADR-0002 (Flutter) in the project

nodes.label: Truth Model
nodes.rationale: Implements the brief's rule never to present fabricated/unverified flights as bookable; nothing climbs a rung without an event

nodes.label: Offer Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Freezes itinerary, components, prices, rule and engine versions so it explains itself after rules change

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox
nodes.rationale: ADR-03: no lost notifications or double sends

nodes.label: Progressive Search Results
nodes.rationale: ADR-05: slow suppliers never block the page

nodes.label: Field-level Encryption
nodes.rationale: ADR-08: dumps and logs never expose passport numbers

nodes.label: No Google-dependent Services (ADR-10)
nodes.rationale: OTP, captcha, maps and fonts must work for users in Iran

nodes.label: packages/domain
nodes.rationale: Pure, no I/O; state machines exhaustively testable

nodes.label: packages/engine
nodes.rationale: Pure itinerary engine; reused by Developer Panel rule simulator

nodes.label: Module Boundary Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforced in CI; modules own tables and expose only index.ts

nodes.label: PermVersionGuard
nodes.rationale: Token perm_version mismatch returns 401 PERMISSIONS_CHANGED

nodes.label: Flight Request State Machine
nodes.rationale: send_quote guard requires all baggage and conditions KNOWN

nodes.label: Optimistic Locking
nodes.rationale: If-Match row version; 409 VERSION_CONFLICT so admins never overwrite each other

nodes.label: Supplier Integration Principles
nodes.rationale: Official contracted interfaces only; normalise at edge; capabilities not names; fail soft

nodes.label: Amadeus Enterprise
nodes.rationale: Status UNKNOWN until account manager confirms product and price

nodes.label: Fake Adapter
nodes.rationale: Refused at start-up in production

nodes.label: Schedules / MCT Data (OAG or Cirium)
nodes.rationale: Rung 1 only, never sold; Stage 7 option

nodes.label: Gateway Start
nodes.rationale: Flights out of Iran scarce (D-01, no Turkish carriers before Mar 2027); hubs/gateways must be data not code

nodes.label: Decision D-03 No Online Payments in v1
Decision D-04 Ground Tickets Out of Scope
Connection Rules
nodes.rationale: Precedence: carrier pair at airport > airport > route > global

nodes.label: joinAtHub
nodes.rationale: Planner, not join, controls cost

nodes.label: Risk Flags
nodes.rationale: Engine flags entry needed but does not decide visa eligibility

nodes.label: API Conventions
nodes.rationale: One versioned schema-first REST API serves web, console and mobile so behaviour is predictable

nodes.label: API Versioning /v1
nodes.rationale: /v1 kept at least 6 months after last mobile release using it, so old app installs keep working

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key
nodes.rationale: Creates and payment/record commands are replayed for 24 h so every write is safe to retry

nodes.label: 404 for Unauthorized Lookups (No Existence Leaks)
nodes.rationale: Returning 404 instead of 403 avoids confirming that a reference exists

nodes.label: Inbound Webhooks
nodes.rationale: Handlers only verify, record and enqueue; processing happens in the worker

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events (Search Progress)
nodes.rationale: Clients re-fetch on results events so the stream stays small and resumable via Last-Event-ID

nodes.label: Four-Eyes Payment Verification
nodes.rationale: Second-person verification by a different user for payments above threshold

nodes.label: OTP Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Passwordless 6-digit codes, 5-min lifetime (slow SMS in Iran), HMAC-stored, constant-time compare, generic error to avoid an oracle

nodes.label: SMS Pumping Abuse Controls
nodes.rationale: Most common OTP attack; layered controls protect customers and the SMS budget

nodes.label: Proof-of-Work Challenge (ALTCHA)
nodes.rationale: reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha avoided as unreliable or contractually problematic for Iranian users

nodes.label: Refresh Token Rotation and Reuse Detection
nodes.rationale: Presenting a rotated token revokes the whole family and session (theft detection)

nodes.label: Email OTP Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Code instead of magic link because links break across devices and are scanned by mail filters

nodes.label: Verified Phone Required for Requests
nodes.rationale: The team's working channel is the phone (brief §7)

nodes.label: perm_version
nodes.rationale: One Redis read per request is the price of making demotions immediate

nodes.label: Transactional Outbox
nodes.rationale: Replaces fragile save-then-send; side effects happen exactly once in effect even across crashes

nodes.label: No Side Effects from Request Handlers Rule
SLA Timers (Delayed Jobs)
nodes.rationale: Each job re-checks state on firing, so a missed removal is harmless

nodes.label: Domain Events
nodes.rationale: Payloads carry identifiers only, never full personal data

nodes.label: Redis Usage
nodes.rationale: Redis is disposable: PostgreSQL holds every record and the outbox re-drives queues; AOF needed for BullMQ

nodes.label: Compliance Engine
nodes.rationale: Turns legal constraints of ch. 4 into automatic checks, holds doubtful cases for a named person, keeps evidence; makes advice enforceable

nodes.label: ATOL Mode (atol.mode)
nodes.rationale: Without own ATOL, tickets must be issued immediately on payment, so default PAY_ON_TICKETING

nodes.label: OFAC SDN List
nodes.rationale: Needed because US secondary sanctions reach non-US firms dealing with designated airlines

nodes.label: Persian Name Matcher
nodes.rationale: Latin transliterations of Iranian names vary widely, so matching is layered: normalise, tokenise, Jaro-Winkler + phonetic, native script, discriminators

nodes.label: Compliance Cases and Decisions
nodes.rationale: Decisions immutable; corrections are new decisions referencing earlier ones

nodes.label: Envelope Encryption (Master Key)
nodes.rationale: Master key never enters the database; provider credentials rotate without redeploy

nodes.label: Self-Hosted Fonts (No Google Services)
nodes.rationale: Google Fonts/Maps unreliable or prohibited for Iranian users (ch. 8)

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Append-only, partitioned monthly, optionally hash-chained so tampering is detectable

nodes.label: Mobile App (Expo / React Native)
nodes.rationale: PROPOSED in booklet; superseded by ADR-0002 (Flutter) in project

nodes.label: Non-FCM Push Provider (Pushy)
nodes.rationale: Expo push relies on FCM which cannot deliver to Android users in Iran

nodes.label: App Distribution Channels
nodes.rationale: Website is the guaranteed channel so no customer depends on an app store

nodes.label: Infrastructure, Deployment and Operations
nodes.rationale: Small, boring, portable; every choice checked against reachability for Iranian visitors

nodes.label: FAKE Supplier Adapter
nodes.rationale: Local/test only; production (APP_ENV) refuses the fake adapter

nodes.label: Deployment Topology
nodes.rationale: No microservices, service mesh or Kubernetes for v1; Docker Compose on two app VMs

nodes.label: Delivery Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Staffed manual-request service goes live before the search engine so customers are served while supplier contracts are negotiated

nodes.label: Milestone M1 Manual Request Service Live
Testing and Quality
nodes.rationale: Tests weighted toward where mistakes are most expensive: state machines, engine, permissions, compliance

nodes.label: Risk Register
nodes.rationale: Biggest risks are external (sanctions, supplier terms, corridor changes), not technical

hyperedges.label: Truth model: seven separate objects from search to payment
Atomic state transition: command, guard, history/audit, outbox
Sanctions and corridor collapse drive gateway/manual-first flight design
Truth ladder: offer to snapshot to reservation to ticket
Search pipeline: plan, join, validate, score, diversify
Command transaction: business rows + history + audit + outbox
